description: Lazy SMP runs iterative deepening of the same root on several threads that share one transposition table. The threads do not split the work: what one thread stores answers or orders the others' searches, and since every other helper starts one ply ahead, the main thread's next iteration is partly in the table before it starts. The main thread spends the budget and decides the result, and the helpers stop when it is done; with the default `satisfices`, the score equals a single-threaded search's at the same depth, while the line and statistics vary from run to run. The table is `SharedTable`, `SlotTable` shards each behind its own lock, and the search is `deepen_shared`, behind the `parallel` feature. Use it for long searches on several cores: on short ones, thread start-up and lock contention cost more than the shared entries save, so measure on the game at hand.
